items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Sam Dutre playing in bands with Amos Rowley and others, but does not state a personal relationship with Dutre himself.

ctx.x: Go ahead and tell you Sam.
Sam Dutre. And they had a fellow by the name of Pope play trombone.
Is that Sam Dutre? Is that the young son or the old man?
